text:
emma_sales: Hey team — customer (MedLedger) asked for SOC 2 artifact pack + signed pen-test letter for the POC. They also want to know if signing by our CISO is required or if a security lead is OK. Also: will Dedicated pricing change if we provide single-tenant staging IPs for their external scan?

jordan_se: @emma_sales short answer: pen-test letter template is OK signed by security lead, but legal sometimes asks for CISO depending on contract. For pricing: dedicated pricing is based on committed GPU capacity not pen-test artifacts; however providing static staging IPs (reserved egress) may incur infra/network charges — could affect quote.

lisa_security: We can sign with 'Head of Security' (Lisa K). CISO signing only for enterprise contracts > $1M ARR or special legal request. Add line: 'no access to customer data beyond agreed scope' and redact internal IPs. I'll attach template to the dataroom.

ben_eng: For scans — prefer presigned uploads + ephemeral staging creds. If they need an internal-facing network diagram, we can provide a sanitized version (remove bastion host keys and internal account IDs). We should not give AWS account IDs or private hostnames.

emma_sales: ok, can you drop the template + a sanitized network diag into the dataroom? Buyer requested a named pen-test contact so they can coordinate scheduling. Timeline: POC kickoff in ~2w.

lisa_security: I'll prep signed letter draft. Who's the signatory email we should use? contracts@redwood.com or legal@redwood.com?

samantha_ciso: use contracts@redwood.com for now, I'll review after Lisa signs. Also: for pen-test scope we require scans limited to staging CIDR only and that raw results are shared to us via encrypted channel (PGP or S3 with SSE-KMS).

jordan_se: For staging creds we'll use presigned S3 (preferred) + SFTP presigned if they insist. Example presign command we typically share:
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-proofpack/poc-medledger.zip --expires-in 86400
```
Include a short README in the bundle describing which artifacts are included and any redaction notes.

ops_bot: ticket REDWOOD-5421 created to track evidence handoff, pen-test letter, and pricing implications. Assignees: @emma_sales @ben_eng @lisa_security. ETA field updated to 2024-08-02.

emma_sales: thanks — I'll update the buyer. @lisa_security can you aim to have the signed PDF by EOD tomorrow? :pray:

lisa_security: yes aiming EOD, will include 'signed by Head of Security' and include pen-test scheduling contact (pen-tests@redwood.com). :white_check_mark:

ben_eng: one more note — if they request dedicated burst capacity for a final scale test we need 72h notice to provision and there may be a pricing add-on (~+15% on committed rate for short-term reserved infra). Call that out in the quote.

samantha_ciso: also confirm whether they require an encryption-at-rest certificate chain for their auditors; if yes, we provide a KMS usage statement and a signed key-management excerpt.

emma_sales: perfect — I'll confirm the encryption ask with procurement and ping back here. cc: @contracts@redwood.com
